name: Gmail MCP Server
description: A privacy-focused MCP server that grants Claude read-only access to Gmail using strict, user-defined filters to control which emails are exposed. It enables searching and fetching email metadata while ensuring data security through OAuth and localized filter enforcement.

GMAIL_FILTER_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path to the filters.yaml configuration file used to define which emails are accessible to the server.
